answer: Each submission hangs on the forge of a task receipt, and the lagoon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
